title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP07b-prep-auth — move and change-trusted-base authorizations for the IFX facade
goal: Add the move and change-trusted-base authorizations that the CP07b-prep change PR will consume and record D27, without changing any trusted component or registered policy.
acceptanceCriteria: A move record binds the base tree entry of tests/LayerGuard.Tests/GatePolicyBindingTests.cs and the head tree entry of tests/LayerGuard.Ifx.Tests/GatePolicyBindingTests.cs, and a change-trusted-base record covers the package-local build locks, the architecture conformance engine, the runner, the architecture conformance tests and the package tests; both are schema-valid and generated from the prepared change.

D27 records the CP07b-prep and CP07b split, the ownership move of IFX constants into trusted binding code with byte-identical policy files, the binding extension point and the explicitly referenced IFX facade; Plan 06 section 17 and the plan pair index both list it.
No trusted component or registered policy changes, nothing is deleted, and all 13 required checks pass.
